record.title: Microduck — the whole robot: trunk, two 5-DoF legs, 4-DoF neck/head, 1-DoF beak; 15 x XL330, 38 distinct parts, 70 placements
record.why: seeded 2026-09-01 with 38 bom rows / 70 placements / 14 hinges; 2 of 14 joints resolved (both knees onto part:microduck-shin#knee, 0.000 mm off axis). The remaining parts are being rebuilt (workflow microduck-rebuild); re-run the seed when they land and read joints.json record.resolved.
record.origin_why: a PORT of Pollen Robotics' Microduck from their published MJCF + meshes (reference/), rebuilt part by part in cecad. Nothing physical has been built or measured; every placement is Pollen's zero-pose transform, cited per row in placements.json.
record.frame: MJCF world at zero pose: +x forward (beak), +y left, +z up; trunk_base body origin at (0, 0, 120); feet 13.5 mm above z=0 in this pose (SPEC.md §2)
record.how_authored: BLUEPRINT.md §2: a fully specified design is authored as bom.json + joints.json directly. `ce-cad/bin/cad-mjcf seed` regenerates bom.json, placements.json, joints.json and cad/assembly.py from the MJCF and spec/mesh-to-part.json; joints resolve their child interface BY MEASUREMENT (the placed interface accepting the connection that lies on the joint axis).
